smith.prompt:
STYLE REFERENCES: Match the painting technique, inked outlines, level of detail, textural brushwork, and lighting of these reference images, but draw a completely different subject and use ONLY the colours written in this prompt.
Aesthetic: Hand-painted dark fantasy illustration, souls-like mobile game art style (Dark Souls, Elden Ring, Gym Oath). Bold expressive black ink outlines defining the outer silhouette and internal anatomy/folds/crevices. Painterly cel-shading with rich but muted weathered colours, deep charcoal shadows (#0D0B09), warm antique gold rim light (#C9A24A), high contrast, sharp graphic readability even when scaled down to a small thumbnail. NO 3D CGI, no photographic skin, no smooth airbrushing, no flat cartoon, no anime, no modern elements.
CRITICAL BACKGROUND RULE: Flat solid magenta background #FF00FF filling the entire canvas from edge to edge. Pure solid uniform magenta #FF00FF background only. Absolutely NEVER use any magenta, fuchsia, or pink on the subject, skin, clothes, props, or effects. No text, no watermark, no frame, no borders, no ground shadow plate, no UI.

SUBJECT: Master Gorran the Blacksmith
Framing: head and upper chest bust only (cut cleanly at mid-chest, just under the shoulders). Three-quarter view turned to the RIGHT of the image, eyes looking right. Head positioned in the upper half of the canvas with a little space above the head, broad powerful shoulders filling the canvas width. Light source from the upper left, plus warm forge glow from below on one side. Weathered, believable person of a grim medieval world, not a hero, not a monster. Clothes are worn and practical: no shiny armour, no rust, nothing dark or corrupted.
DETAILS: Master Gorran the Blacksmith. Big bald man in his forties, thick braided red-brown beard with a few singed hairs. Black soot smudges on his forehead and rugged cheeks, thick powerful neck. Heavy leather apron over a sleeveless sweat-darkened coarse grey shirt, thick hairy muscular forearm visible at the bottom edge, a pair of heavy iron blacksmith tongs resting casually over his shoulder. Glow of the forge lighting him warm orange from below on one side. Colours strictly: steel grey, leather brown, forge orange, natural ruddy skin tones. Bold inked outlines.
